# Sri Kalakshi School of Dance

> Bharatanatyam lessons led by Smt. Ranjana Vinodkumar, with more than 35 years of dance behind her.

Website: https://srikalakshi.weebly.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: 044 2450 2744

## Key facts
- the year we began 2007
- 150 students, around
- 300 dance shows by our students, and more
- 20 arangetrams completed

## Facilities
- Adavus
- Margam
- Theory
- Talam
- Grade exams
- Nattuvangam
- Diploma in Bharathanatyam
- Diploma in Nattuvangam
- Bachelor's degree in dance
- Master's degree in dance
- Thematic solo programs
- Thematic group productions
- Adult batch on weekend mornings

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sri Kalakshi School of Dance?
Clasic Farms, Sholinganallur, Chennai.

### What facilities does Sri Kalakshi School of Dance have?
Adavus, Margam, Theory, Talam, Grade exams, Nattuvangam, Diploma in Bharathanatyam, Diploma in Nattuvangam, Bachelor's degree in dance, Master's degree in dance, Thematic solo programs, Thematic group productions, Adult batch on weekend mornings.

### Where are the classes?
At Clasic Farms, Sholinganallur (Mon/Wed or Tue/Thu evenings) and near Indian Bank, Rajakilpakkam (Fri and Sat evenings).

### Is there a batch for adults?
Yes, an exclusive adult batch on weekend mornings.

### How do I join Sri Kalakshi School of Dance?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page, call 044 2450 2744 or email danceatkalakshi@gmail.com.
